title: LLM Adaptation and Runtime
subtitle: Data, Post-Training, Inference, and Model Change
description: A professional guide to evidence-led model adaptation, data design, post-training, runtime qualification, and reversible change.
author: Komal Nakrani

chapters.title: Start From a Frozen Behavior Baseline
chapters.summary: Turn a negative adaptation referral into a falsifiable investigation anchored to an exact, replayable behavior baseline.

chapters.title: Inspect the Model and Tokenizer Boundary
chapters.summary: Inspect model, tokenizer, template, precision, and runtime as separate compatibility surfaces without turning architecture into a quality forecast.

chapters.title: Choose the Smallest Adaptation Ladder
chapters.summary: Map each residual failure to the smallest plausible intervention, reject mismatched methods, and attach disconfirmation and stop rules before training.

chapters.title: Specify the Data Recipe
chapters.summary: Turn a conditional adaptation hypothesis into a reproducible, authority-aware data recipe before collecting or transforming examples.

chapters.title: Curate, Deduplicate, and Separate
chapters.summary: Execute the data recipe as an auditable pipeline that preserves rejected records, detects indirect overlap, and freezes purpose-separated dataset vaults.

chapters.title: Build Instruction and Demonstration Data
chapters.summary: Turn clean synthetic partitions into evidence-linked, template-correct instruction records with intentional loss regions and visible coverage gaps.

chapters.title: Build Preference and Feedback Data
chapters.summary: Turn comparative judgments into criterion-specific, randomized, bias-audited evidence without treating preference as truth.

chapters.title: Preserve Retention and Control Cases
chapters.summary: Freeze target, retention, multilingual, abstention, safety, and no-change lanes so adaptation cannot hide forbidden regressions.

chapters.title: Establish the Training Experiment
chapters.summary: Specify an inspectable, resumable training experiment whose state, resources, behavioral hooks, and stop rules are frozen before execution.

chapters.title: Supervise the Model
chapters.summary: Separate supervised token optimization from held-out behavior evidence, then select or reject checkpoints across target, retention, language, control, and resource slices.

chapters.title: Adapt Efficiently With PEFT
chapters.summary: Evaluate low-rank adapters as traceable behavior-and-resource candidates whose base, tokenizer, template, runtime, quantization, and merge state must remain compatible.

chapters.title: Optimize Preferences Carefully
chapters.summary: Treat preference optimization as a bounded proxy experiment whose value must survive independent target, retention, language, control, and bias evaluation.

chapters.title: Decide on Distillation or Continued Pretraining
chapters.summary: Choose advanced adaptation only when its mechanism, transfer source, authority, and disconfirming evidence match a distinct residual gap.

chapters.title: Package and Version the Model System
chapters.summary: Bind every behavior-facing component, lineage link, compatibility result, limitation, and rollback state into one fail-closed release identity.

chapters.title: Reason About Inference Memory and Throughput
chapters.summary: Build a workload-specific resource model that separates weights, KV state, prefill, decode, concurrency, throughput, and latency tails.

chapters.title: Compress, Serve, and Preserve Behavior
chapters.summary: Select serving variants on an expiring behavior-resource frontier, with exact compatibility, protected replay, and graceful degradation.

chapters.title: Release, Diagnose, and Evolve Adapted Models
chapters.summary: Close the series with an authority-preserving release, incident, rollback, requalification, and durable-learning loop across the complete model-system dossier.

appendicesSummary: Adaptation measurement and optimization recall, model/data/artifact identity, reusable Mosaic dossier artifacts, provider-neutral companion guidance, inference and distributed-systems recall, terminology and adjacent-role boundaries, and publication provenance records.
figureRegistryNote: The 34 figures are original synthetic ImageGen PNG teaching illustrations for the fictional Mosaic Desk case. They explain adaptation, data, training, packaging, inference, serving, and change relationships; they do not report trained-model, product, user, capacity, or production outcomes.
